name: Kenéz (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light grey over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kenéz: a blue shield with a white church tower, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed KENÉZ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kenéz arms with wreath and scroll
